title: Teach MealPlanParser to round-trip free-text items
description: Update meal-plan parsing and serialisation so non-empty non-recipe/non-ingredient lines become `.text` items while existing section-header behaviour remains intact.
acceptance_criteria: Parser emits `.text(line)` for eligible free-text lines inside sections.
Whitespace-only lines are dropped rather than emitted as text items.
Serialiser writes `.text` items verbatim and preserves canonical ordering.
Existing recipe, ingredient, and section-header parsing behaviour remains intact.

handoff_summary.completed: Updated `MealPlanParser.parse()` to replace `guard let item = parseItem(trimmedLine) else { continue }` with `let item = parseItem(trimmedLine) ?? .text(trimmedLine)`. Whitespace-only lines continue to be dropped by the existing empty-check guard at line 58. All other patterns (block headings, section headers, comments, `@` items) are checked before this line and short-circuit with `continue`, so existing behaviour is fully preserved.
handoff_summary.remaining: Tester agent should add test cases: (1) free-text line inside a named section emits `.text`; (2) whitespace-only line is not emitted; (3) round-trip serialise/parse of a plan containing `.text` items.
handoff_summary.risks: A line ending in `:` with a non-empty name is still parsed as a section header (not `.text`). A line starting with `@` that fails CookbookCore's ingredient parser now becomes `.text` rather than being dropped — this is correct for round-trip fidelity but is a behaviour change for malformed entries.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the new `.text` emission behaviour with dedicated unit tests and confirm the existing `fixtureRoundTripsThroughSerialise` test still passes.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected; MealPlanParser.swift is only modified in the parse() body and no sibling beads are known to touch this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `?? .text(trimmedLine)` rather than an explicit if-let branch to keep the change minimal and readable. The `trimmedLine` (already trimmed) is used as the text payload, matching existing item-parsing convention.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Existing `fixtureRoundTripsThroughSerialise` covers round-trip for `.menu` files without free-text lines. New tests needed for the free-text path.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The current `parseSectionHeader` check runs before the `.text` fallback, so a line like `Note:` (valid section-header syntax) will always be treated as a section header, never as `.text`. This is intentional per the spec.

conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected; MealPlanParser.swift is only modified in the parse() body and no sibling beads are known to touch this file.

execution_history.summary: Added `.text` item emission to MealPlanParser. Non-empty lines inside a block that are not block headings, section headers, comments, or valid `@` items are now emitted as `.text(trimmedLine)` instead of being silently dropped. The serialiser already handled `.text` items correctly. One-line change; build passes clean.
